exam_scheme.note: The All India Law Entrance Test (AILET) is conducted annually by National Law University, Delhi (NLU Delhi) for admission into its five-year integrated B.A. LL.B. (Hons.), LL.M., and Ph.D. degree programmes. AILET is an offline pen-and-paper examination administered using OMR answer sheets across designated test cities in India. For the B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) programme, the examination comprises 150 multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each (total 150 marks) to be solved within 120 minutes duration. The question paper contains three sections: Section A - English Language (50 questions, 50 marks), Section B - Current Affairs & General Knowledge (30 questions, 30 marks), and Section C - Logical Reasoning (70 questions, 70 marks). Marking scheme: 1 mark awarded for each correct response, negative marking of 0.25 marks deducted for each incorrect response, and 0 marks for unattempted questions.
